text:
maria_support: FYI - customer Acme opened an escalation: sudden tail-latency spikes on /v1/embeddings starting ~1.5h ago after increasing client max_batch_size to 256. p99s jumping to 3-7s, plus sporadic 500s and occasional 401s.
acme_product: we rolled the client change at 12:05 UTC. No server-side deploys on our end. Small payloads (2-6 items), model=open-embed-v1, expected dim=1536.
sunil_engineer: grabbing coalescer and routing traces. Any sample request id?
maria_support: sample request req-9a2b7c11. Response included one vector of length 768, then batch failed with 500.
jess_oncall: pulled traces. Coalescer aggregated many small requests (client_max_batch 256 + default coalesce_window 15ms) into mixed batches. Some shards responded with open-embed-v1-quantized (768) while others returned full-dim (1536) causing server-side concat/assert errors. Also saw a burst of 401s that correlate with rotated tokens from the client side.
bot_deploy: note: open-embed-v1 variant rollout: staggered quantized variant enabled at 09:40 UTC for certain shards (traffic-based).
nora_perf: log excerpt:
```
[2799994321] coalescer: recv req=req-9a2b7c11, client_max_batch=256
[2799994322] coalescer: batch formed size=120 -> route=open-embed-v1:shard-7
[2799994323] runtime: shard-7 fallback-> open-embed-v1-quant768
[2799994327] runtime: batch latency=4700ms
[2799994328] respond: error=500 "embedding dim mismatch"
[2799994330] auth: token expired for client=acme-app-23 (401) - client retried
```
maria_support: so two issues: (1) mixed-variant batching causing dim mismatch and 500s, (2) client tokens expired causing brief 401 storms that amplify coalescer pressure. Correct?
sunil_engineer: yes. The coalescer logic currently optimizes for throughput and will pack up to client_max_batch across candidate backends; it didn't consider cross-variant embedding_dim equality. Under shard pressure, scheduler will fall back to quantized variants which are faster but produce different dims.
jess_oncall: Short-term mitigation for customer: set client_max_batch_size to 32 (or 16) and add request header "x-prefer-variant: full". That reduces large coalesced batches and avoids fallback to quantized. Also advise to ensure token refreshes are handled gracefully to avoid 401 bursts.
acme_product: we applied max_batch_size=32 and fixed token refresh logic (was racing). After 30m p99 back to ~180ms and no 500s. Good so far.
maria_support: created ticket S-9980 to pin Acme's route to non-quantized variant until runtime fix lands.
billing_bot: route pin S-9980 noted (non-billable). Confirming pin to open-embed-v1:stable.
nora_perf: root cause write-up draft: when client_max_batch > shard headroom and coalesce_window is large, batches span multiple shards/variants; fallback-to-quantized under pressure + KV-cache coldness yields multi-second tails and occasional dim mismatch exceptions. Token churn contributed to transient load spikes.
sunil_engineer: action items:
- runtime: add pre-batch compatibility check that candidate backends for a coalesced batch must advertise identical embedding_dim; if not, split by variant (PR #4521) - sunil
- platform: implement route-pin for embeddings (support UI/API flag) - jess
- documentation: recommend client best-practices for max_batch_size and token refresh backoff - support - maria
- monitoring: add alert on mixed-variant-response-rate > 0.1% and spike in embedding-dim mismatches - nora
jess_oncall: temporary configuration applied for Acme: route pinned and coalesce_window reduced to 4ms for their zone. Monitoring shows stable latency for 40m.
maria_support: shared repro script with customer that simulates coalescing pressure (adjusted for their environment):
```
# run from bash on mac/linux
for i in $(seq 1 300); do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"model":"open-embed-v1","input":["a","b","c"],"max_batch_size":256}' &
  sleep 0.01
done
wait
```
acme_product: repro validated locally - we were able to reproduce mixed-dim error before the pin. After pin, no dim errors.
maria_support: updating S-9980: customer on reduced max_batch_size=32, route pinned, token fix deployed. We'll keep ticket open until runtime PR lands and canary is healthy.
sunil_engineer: target timeline: PR landed in staging today, canary next 24-48h. We'll post in #eng-oncall before deploying.
jess_oncall: closing loop for support channel. Reopen if latency resurfaces. :thumbsup:
